items.stem: Which DAX function evaluates an expression in a modified filter context and is the basis for most advanced measures?

options.rationale: Correct: CALCULATE evaluates an expression in a modified filter context and underpins most advanced DAX.
SUM is a simple aggregation; it does not modify filter context.
CONCATENATE joins text and has nothing to do with filter context.
FORMAT converts a value to text; it does not change filter context.

items.explanation: Correct: CALCULATE evaluates an expression in a modified filter context and underpins most advanced DAX.

items.stem: A measure using time-intelligence functions returns blanks across the matrix. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: There is no properly marked date table in the model
options.rationale: Correct: most time-intelligence functions require a proper, contiguous date table.

options.text: The report theme is set to dark mode
options.rationale: Visual theming does not affect DAX evaluation.
A paused capacity would stop everything, not blank one measure.

options.text: The measure name is too long
options.rationale: Measure name length does not cause blank time-intelligence results.

items.explanation: Correct: most time-intelligence functions require a proper, contiguous date table.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about DAX measures and calculated columns are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: A measure is evaluated in the filter context of each cell at query time
options.rationale: Correct: measures are dynamic and evaluated per cell in the current context.

options.text: A calculated column is computed row by row and stored in the model
options.rationale: Correct: calculated columns use row context and are materialized in the model.

options.text: A measure stores one static value in the table
options.rationale: Measures are dynamic, not a single stored value.

options.text: A calculated column changes with each slicer selection
options.rationale: Calculated columns are computed at refresh, not per slicer selection.

items.explanation: Correct: measures are dynamic and evaluated per cell in the current context.
